field_text_formatted.value: Vale ran over every draft with this site's rules and caught 15 errors, from sentences stacked on the same opening to a stock "not this, but that" contrast. Simulated readers, one per audience, then reviewed it three times and caught what a linter can't: claims that didn't match the module. Each was fixed before you read it. Vale checks the sentence and ignores the author, so a model's prose meets the same rules as mine.
